create_FitsDict: create a FitsDict instance to track best SMPL pose fits per image in the training set
save_FitsDict: save the FitsDict state to disk as numpy arrays in the checkpoint directory
retrieve_FitsDict_getitem: retrieve pose, betas, and validity tensors from the FitsDict for a batch of images
update_FitsDict_setitem: update FitsDict entries with new pose and betas parameters after undoing flip and rotation
flip_pose_SMPL: flip SMPL pose parameters by permuting joints and negating axis-angle dimensions for mirrored images
